description: Dear Neighbor,As summer turns to fall, I’ve been grateful for the chance to spend time with so many of you across Lenoir, Greene, and Jones Counties while also staying hard at work in Raleigh.This month’s newsletter includes updates from across our district, reflections on leaders we’ve lost, and celebrations of the good work happening in our schools and communities. I hope you’ll take a few minutes to read through the highlights.As always, if my office can ever be of help to you or your family,
